title.hook: You run Wales from 2026 to 2050. Leave it better than you found it. In 2050 a young person writes to tell you how you did.
title.playNote: About 20 minutes. 6 turns of 4 years, like Senedd terms. Every figure on the map is real.
title.resumeNote: Your last game is saved in this browser.
title.exploreNote: 22 council areas and 87 real measures, each with its source.
title.readNote: Every rule, number and source. You can change some of the rules.
title.honest: A thinking tool, not a forecast. An independent project, not an official view.
title.lineAria: A timeline from 2026, now, to 2050, where a sealed letter waits.
